summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl.py. Results: test_shacl.py and test/test_path.py pass (42 passed); all of test/test_extras passes (100 passed, 2 skipped, 3 xfailed). Nothing was committed. Not verified: mypy, black, and isort are not installed in the shared venv or anywhere on the machine, so type-checking and formatting were checked only by reading. Choices: the non-node guard reads the argument through an object-typed local to avoid a warn_unreachable false positive; modifiers use one explicit branch each; the parametrized test branches on whether the expected value is a path or an exception type.
